what: Captures the physical memory of a Windows computer to a raw file with a small footprint, so memory artifacts can be examined later. Version 1.20 lists Windows XP to 10 and several Server editions.
Creates full memory dumps of Windows systems (x86, x64, ARM64) that open in tools such as WinDbg. No agent is needed and it can be run from PowerShell.
Single executable that collects RAM, event logs, registry hives and other key files from a live endpoint, with a guided two-step run. Output is a hashed zip file.
Takes scrolling snapshots of listed web pages, builds an HTML report and can keep results in a single SQLite database. Needs Windows 7 or later.
Command-line check that looks for TrueCrypt, PGP, VeraCrypt, Check Point, SafeBoot and BitLocker volumes on local drives, so examiners know if a live capture is needed.
Captures memory from individual running processes instead of the whole system, which can give less fragmented data for later searching.
Acquires images of iOS and Android phones and tablets, plus computers, drives and removable media. Offers quick, full and targeted extraction modes.
cost_note: Free for the forensics community, registration form

what: Loads Android app data from a case into a virtual environment so examiners can browse it much as the user saw it. Works with output from other forensic tools. Needs Windows 10 on Intel.
Portable viewer for UFDR reports produced by a lab. Supports keyword search, timeline, bookmarks and focused report export for people who receive reports.
cost_note: Free, sign-in to the Cellebrite Community Portal

what: Free viewer for mobile extraction data with search, filtering, tagging and export to PDF, Word, Excel and other formats. Needs no installation or licence.
cost_note: Free, registration to get the download link

what: Windows tool to create hash-verified images of drives and folders, preview evidence before imaging, and capture RAM from a live system. Does not handle mobile devices.

Collects chosen files and artifacts with targets, then runs modules to process them. Free for government, education and research, and internal company use; a licence is needed for third-party or paid work.
cost_note: Free for government, education, research and internal use; licence for commercial engagements

what: Small Windows tool that dumps volatile memory, including memory protected against dumping. Runs from a USB drive without installation.
Portable Windows triage tool run from a USB drive to find email, chats and browser data quickly, collect a RAM dump and export results for Belkasoft X.
cost_note: Free (page does not state registration terms)

what: Converts timestamps from desktop and mobile systems into readable dates and times, and encodes them back. Version 5 lists 69 formats.
Extracts a byte range or partition from an image or device into a flat file, converts E01 images, and hashes the output with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512.
Scans a computer for password-protected files and encrypted containers such as BitLocker and TrueCrypt, and reports recovery options.
Shows passwords hidden behind asterisks in dialog boxes. The vendor lists it as a legacy product that is no longer supported.
No-install utility that scans a system for BitLocker, VeraCrypt and TrueCrypt containers and encrypted virtual machines, then writes a short report.
cost_note: Free under Elcomsoft free licence, no redistribution

what: Command-line tool that mounts HFS and APFS file system images from older iOS devices on Windows.
cost_note: Free under Elcomsoft free licence, no redistribution

what: Open-source software that turns a single-board computer such as a Raspberry Pi into a firewall used when sideloading the vendor extraction agent on iOS.
Windows tool that links network connections to the processes behind them and checks hashes and domains against online reputation services. The vendor post is from 2013.
Mounts raw, forensic and virtual machine images as real disks in Windows, with temporary write support and BitLocker unlocking. Some features need the paid Professional Mode.

Collection of Windows utilities such as Process Explorer, Process Monitor, Autoruns and Sysmon, widely used to inspect running systems. The licence FAQ says there is no charge but redistribution is not allowed.
Extracts static, stack and decoded strings from malware, including obfuscated ones. Published by Mandiant on GitHub.
Reports what a program appears able to do by inspecting PE, ELF, .NET, shellcode and sandbox reports. Published by the Mandiant FLARE team on GitHub.
Mounts raw, E01, VHD, VMDK and other disk images as drive letters, read-only by default, and can create RAM disks. Needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 for current versions.
Bootable CD or USB tool that makes raw, AFF or EWF images and clones with hash checks, independent of the installed system. Open source under GPL v3.
Windows graphical front end for Volatility that detects the platform and lists commands, so memory dumps can be examined without Python setup.
Writes one image to several USB drives at once, writes ISO files, and can zero or reformat drives. May be shared only unmodified and not sold.
Collects volatile data, user activity and startup items from a USB drive, local run or disk image, and shows them with a timeline and HTML report. Lacks automated scoring.
cost_note: Free, request form; paid features trial for 7 days
source_label: Cyber Triage: free incident response post

what: Disk filter that blocks writes to the Master Boot Record. Talos offers an open-source version and a signed driver and says it is unsupported.
Ruby tool that lists PE section hashes to help build section-based ClamAV signatures for known packers.
Open-source platform that collects forensic evidence and hunts across many endpoints using VQL queries, and can also be used for local triage.
